youtube.title: How Shri Ram Was Born | Ramayana Ep 3
youtube.description:
You know Shri Ram was born on Ram Navami. But do you know his birth began with one bowl of divine pudding? 🏹

King Dasharatha of Ayodhya had everything except a son. He performed the great Ashvamedha with the sage Rishyashringa. From the sacred fire rose a radiant being with a golden vessel of payasa (kheer), which the king shared among his three queens. Then, on the ninth day of Chaitra, Rama was born, and that is why we celebrate Ram Navami.

📜 On screen (Valmiki Ramayana 1.16.27):
"Kausalyāyai narapatiḥ pāyasārdhaṁ dadau tadā, ardhād ardhaṁ dadau cāpi sumitrāyai narādhipaḥ"
